title: Shinonome Akito — How We Each Spend Our Days Off〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: How We Each Spend Our Days Off（2★）

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... It may be better to emphasize the bass section more for that last part.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
That should give the chorus a little more pop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then, let's make that adjustment.
We can have Azusawa and Shiraishi listen to it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tomorrow...? That's sooner than normal. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, and please don't worry.
I don't plan on staying up that late to work on this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What about you though? I noticed that you came here early to practice on your own. Please, try not to push yourself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is nothing.
And I don't want to make you worry again by doing too much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, between practice and making your own track, you're not exactly taking it easy either. That means I should also be doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Sounds like your efforts have lit a flame under Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The same goes for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like him, I want to do what I can as well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: These guys are like...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Well, I see no problem if they're saying that they're okay.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: However, how one performs can change drastically based on the way they spend their time preparing.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, that's very true.
You can try all you want, but it's all for naught if you're too exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that...
But don't you guys do stuff outside of our joint practices?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I usually crash and fall asleep whenever I feel really tired. I'm usually all ready to sing by the time I wake up the next day!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was asking about how you guys practice...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: He may be a bit of an extreme example, but I also like to rest whenever I can.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I usually use that time to listen to our songs or watch videos of our shows to imagine how we're going to perform.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I also prefer to take it easy the day before long practices or rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I may try to get a breath of fresh air by traveling somewhere far away to take photos or something else that's unrelated to music.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Those sorts of trips can also lead to some nice inspiration. Seeing things from new perspectives tend to help me put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
See? I'm not crazy!
Taking breaks and resting is really important!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It sounds less compelling when you say it...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: In any case, working hard isn't the only way to put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, why not set aside some days here and there to stop and smell the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see... Then, it may be good for us to make some adjustments to our practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
But for now, we gotta keep working on our new songs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can come back to that after the event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it? You got something to say?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
No, not really.
It's just... You seem all prickly most of the time, but you're really not deep down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought you were pretty stubborn and unbending at first, but you're more flexible than I initially realized.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Give me some credit...
Of course I'm willing to try things that could prove beneficial to my team.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, sorry, I wasn't trying to be mean or anything.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be looking forward to hearing Vivid BAD SQUAD's new songs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It goes without saying that we're gonna blow the roof off the place.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hehe. I like that...
With the time we have left, let's all do our best to make our event a good one.
